brief: Holds the agent guardrails as one set of graph rules, reproducing the hand-written governance checks.
detail: It is born with six rules: no-llm-effectful, effects-guarded, open-text-contained, effects-traced, effects-dominated (every path to an effect passes through a guardian) and external-data-contained. A project adds its own with AddRule. It judges an agent graph the way StzCheckAgentGraph does, on the same nodes.
